answer: Each of 328 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A mining claim record with geological survey attestation works as the gate: a claim staked years ago and recorded in the geological survey register. The horizon check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The falcon record is public, the vertex cost is per identity, and 328 aliases cost 328 times one honest seat.
